verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              एवं दुर्योधने राजन् गर्जमाने मुहुर्मुहुः। युधिष्ठिरस्य सङ्क्रुद्धो वासुदेवोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said While Duryodhana, O king, was repeatedly crying aloud in this way, Vasudeva, worked up with wrath, said to Yudhishthira.

verses.sanskrit: यदि नाम ह्ययं युद्धे वरयेत्त्वां युधिष्ठिर। अर्जुनं नकुलं चैव सहदेवमथापि वा॥२॥
verses.english: What indiscreet words have you given vent to, O king, saying that killing one amongst us be you the king of Kurus. If, indeed, O Yudhishthira, Duryodhana selects you for battle or Arjuna or Nakula or Sahadeva, (what will be the consequence?

verses.sanskrit: किमिदं साहसं राजंस्त्वया व्याहृतमीदृशम्। एकमेव निहत्याजौ भव राजा कुरुष्विति॥३॥
न समर्थानहं मन्ये गदाहस्तस्य संयुगे। एतेन हि कृता योग्या वर्षाणीह त्रयोदश॥४॥
verses.english: With a view to kill Bhimasena, O king, Duryodhana has practiced with the mace upon a statue of iron.

verses.sanskrit: आयसे पुरुषे राजन् भीमसेनजिघांसया। कथं नाम भवेत्कार्यमस्याभिर्भरतर्षभ॥५॥
साहसं कृतवांस्त्वं तु ह्यनुक्रोशान्नृपोत्तम। नान्यमस्यानुपश्यामि प्रतियोद्धारमाहवे॥६॥
verses.english: How then, O best of Bharata's race will our object be accomplished? From pity, O best of kings, you have acted very indiscreetly.

verses.sanskrit: ऋते वृकोदरात्पार्थात्स च नातिकृतश्रमः। तदिदं द्यूतमारब्धं पुनरेव यथा पुरा॥७॥
verses.english: I do not at this moment see any match for Duryodhana except Pritha's son Vrikodara. His practice again, with the mace, is not so great.

verses.sanskrit: विषमं शकुनेश्चैव तव चैव विशाम्पते। बली भीमः समर्थश्च कृती राजा सुयोधनः॥८॥
verses.english: You have, therefore, once more given preference to a game of chance as that one formerly between yourself and Shakuni, O monarch.
verses.bhavadeepa: शकुनेश्च तव च यथा पुरा तथैवेदमिति द्वयोः सम्बन्धः॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: बलवान्वा कृती वेति कृती राजन्विशिष्यते। सोऽयं राजंस्त्वया शत्रुः समे पथि निवेशितः॥९॥
verses.english: Bhima is endued with might and prowess, King Duryodhana, however, is skillful. In a fight between might and skill, he, that is skillful, O king, always becomes successful.

verses.sanskrit: न्यस्तश्चात्मा सुविषमे कृच्छ्रमापादिता वयम्। को नु सर्वान्विनिर्जित्य शत्रूनेकेन वैरिणा॥१०॥
verses.english: Such an enemy, O king, you have, by your words placed in a comfortable and secure position. You have placed your oneself, however, in a difficult position. We have, for this, been placed in great peril.

verses.sanskrit: कृच्छ्रप्राप्तेन च तथा हारयेद्राज्यमागतम्। पणित्वा चैकपाणेन रोचयेदेवमाहवम्॥११॥
verses.english: I do not see such a man in the world today, be he a god, who is able to defeat the macearmed Duryodhana in battle.

verses.sanskrit: न हि पश्यामि तं लोके योऽद्य दुर्योधनं रणे। गदाहस्तं विजेतुं वै शक्तः स्यादमरोऽपि हि॥१२॥
न त्वं भीमो न नकुलः सहदेवोऽथ फाल्गुनः। जेतुं न्यायेन शक्तोः वै कृती राजा सुयोधनः॥१३॥
verses.english: Neither you, nor Bhima, nor Nakula nor Sahadeva, nor Phalguna is capable of defeating Duryodhana in fair fight. King Duryodhana is endued with great skill.

verses.sanskrit: स कथं वदसे शत्रुं युध्यस्व गदयेति हि। एकं च नो निहत्याजौ भव राजेति भारत॥१४॥
वृकोदरं समासाद्य संशयो वै जये हि नः। न्यायतो युध्यमानानां कृती ह्येष महाबलः॥१५॥
verses.english: If Duryodhana meets Vrikodara amongst us wishing to fight fairly with him, even then our victory will hang in the balance. Duryodhana is highly powerful and skillful.

verses.sanskrit: एकं वास्मान्निहत्य त्वं भव राजेति वै पुनः। नूनं न राज्यभागेषा पाण्डोः कुन्त्याश्च सन्ततिः॥१६॥
verses.english: How could you say to him-"Killing only one amongst us be you the king." Forsooth the children of Pandu and Kunti are not destined to enjoy kingdom. They have been born for passing their lives in continued exile in the forest or in mendicancy.

verses.sanskrit:
अत्यन्तवनवासाय सृष्टा भैक्ष्याय वा पुनः।
              भीमसेन उवाच।
              मधुसूदन मा कार्षीर्विषादं यदुनन्दन॥१७॥
अद्य पारं गमिष्यामि वैरस्य भृशदुर्गमम्। अहं सुयोधनं सङ्ख्ये हनिष्यामि न संशयः॥१८॥
verses.english: Bhimasena said O killer of Madhu, do not, O delighted of the Yadus, grieve. However difficult it may be, I shall terminate these hostilities.

verses.sanskrit: विजयो वै ध्रुवः कृष्ण धर्मराजस्य दृश्यते। अध्यर्धेन गुणेनेयं गदा गुरुतरी मम॥१९॥
verses.english: Forsooth, I shall kill Suyodhana in battle. It appears, O Krishna, that the victory of righteous Yudhishthira is certain.

verses.sanskrit: न तथा धार्तराष्ट्रस्य मा कार्षीर्माधव व्यथाम्। अहमेनं हि गदया संयुगे योद्धमुत्सहे॥२०॥
verses.english: This mace of mine is heavier by one and a half times than Duryodhana's. Do no, O Madhava, grieve.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तः प्रेक्षकाः सर्वे मम सन्तु जनार्दन। सामरानपि लोकांस्त्रीन्नानाशस्त्रधरान् युधि॥२१॥
verses.english: I dare fight him, selecting the mace as the weapon. Let all of you, O Janarddana, witness this encounter.

verses.sanskrit:
योधयेयं रणे कृष्ण किमुताद्य सुयोधनम्।
              सञ्जय उवाच।
              तथा सम्भाषमाणं तु वासुदेवो वृकोदरम्॥२२॥
verses.english: What do you say of Suyodhana, I would fight with the three worlds including the very celestials even if they be armed with every kind of weapon.

verses.sanskrit: हृष्टः सम्पूजयामास वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्। त्वामाश्रित्य महाबाहो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥२३॥
verses.english: Sanjaya continued After Vrikodara had said these words, Vasudeva, filled with glee, applauded him highly and said to him-"Depending on you, O you of great arms, the righteous king Yudhishthira will, forsooth, get back his prosperity after the destruction of all his foes.

verses.sanskrit: निहतारिः स्वकां दीप्तां श्रियं प्राप्तो न संशयः। त्वया विनिहताः सर्वे धृतराष्ट्रसुता रणे॥२४॥
राजानो राजपुत्राश्च नागाश्च विनिपातिताः। कलिङ्गा मागधाः प्राच्या गान्धाराः कुरवस्तथा॥२५॥
verses.english: You have slain all the sons of Dhritarashtra in battle. At your hands many kings and princes and elephants have met with their death.

verses.sanskrit: त्वामासाद्य महायुद्धे निहताः पाण्डुनन्दन। हत्वा दुर्योधन चापि प्रयच्छोर्वीं ससागराम्॥२६॥
verses.english: The Kalingas, the Magadhas, the Kauravas, the Westerners and the Gandharvas have all been killed in dreadful battles, O son of Pandu.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मराजाय कौन्तेय यथा विष्णुः शचीपतेः। त्वां च प्राप्य रणे पापो धार्तराष्ट्रो विनंक्ष्यति॥२७॥
verses.english: Killing Duryodhana then, O son of Kunti, bestow the earth with her oceans upon the righteous Yudhishthira like Vishnu conferring the sovereignty of the three worlds upon the lord of Shachi.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमस्य सक्थिनी भङ्क्त्वा प्रतिज्ञां पालयिष्यसि। यत्नेन तु सदा पार्थ योद्धव्यो धृतराष्ट्रजः॥२८॥
verses.english: Getting you for a foe in battle, the wretched son of Dhritarashtra, will forsooth meet with his death. You will certainly fulfill your promise by breaking his bones.

verses.sanskrit: कृती च बलवांश्चैव युद्धशौण्डश्च नित्यदा। ततस्तु सात्यकी राजन्पूजयामास पाण्डवम्॥२९॥
verses.english: You should however, O son of Pritha, always fight with care with the son of Dhritarashtra. He is endued with both skill and strength and always finds delight in battle.

verses.sanskrit: पञ्चालाः पाण्डवेयाश्च धर्मराजपुरोगमाः। तद्वचो भीमसेनस्य सर्व एवाभ्यपूजयन्॥३०॥
verses.english: The Panchalas and the Pandavas, also, headed by the righteous king Yudhishthira, all praised Bhimasena.

verses.sanskrit: ततो भीमबलो भीमो युधिष्ठिरमथाब्रवीत्। सृञ्जयैः सह तिष्ठन्तं तपन्तमिव भास्करम्॥३१॥
अहमेतेन सङ्गम्य संयुगे योद्धमुत्सहे। न हि शक्तो रणे जेतुं मामेष पुरुषाधमः॥३२॥
verses.english: Then Bhima, of terrible might, addressed Yudhishthira who was standing amid the Srinjayas like the burning Sun himself, saying-"I venture to fight with this man in battle. This wretch among men is not able to defeat me in fight.

verses.sanskrit: अद्य क्रोधं विमोक्ष्यामि निहितं हृदये भृशम्। सुयोधने धार्तराष्ट्रे खाण्डवेऽग्निमिवार्जुनः॥३३॥
verses.english: Today I shall vomit that ire which has been ranking in my bosom against Suyodhana the son of Dhritarashtra like Arjuna throwing fire on the forest of Khandava.

verses.sanskrit: शल्यमद्योद्धरिष्यामि तव पाण्डवहृच्छयम्। निहत्य गदया पापमद्य राजन् सुखी भव॥३४॥
अद्य कीर्तिमयीं मालां प्रतिमोक्ष्ये तवानघ। प्राणाञ्श्रियं च राज्यं च मोक्ष्यतेऽद्य सुयोधनः॥३५॥
राजा च धृतराष्ट्रोऽद्य श्रुत्वा पुत्रं मया हतम्। स्मरिष्यत्यशुभं कर्म यत्तच्छकुनिबुद्धिजम्॥३६॥
इत्युक्त्वा भरतश्रेष्ठो गदामुद्यम्य वीर्यवान्। उदतिष्ठत युद्धाय शक्रो वृत्रमिवाह्वयन्॥३७॥
तदाह्वानममृष्यन् वै तव पुत्रोऽतिवीर्यवान्। प्रत्युपस्थित एवाशु मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम्॥३८॥
verses.english: Unable to endure that call your highly energetic son, proceeded to the encounter, like one infuriate elephant proceeding to assail another.

verses.sanskrit: गदाहस्त तव सुतं युद्धाय समुपस्थितम्। ददृशुः पाण्डवाः सर्वे कैलासमिव शृङ्गिणम्॥३९॥
verses.english: The Pandavas saw your son, as he came armed with mace, as the summit of the mount Kailasa.

verses.sanskrit: तमेकाकिनमासाद्य धार्तराष्ट्रं महाबलम्। वियूथमिव मातङ्गं समहष्यन्त पाण्डवाः॥४०॥
verses.english: Verily beholding that powerful son of yours standing alone like a prince of elephants separated from the herd, the Pandavas were filled with joy.

verses.sanskrit: न सम्भ्रमो न च भयं न च ग्लानिर्न च व्यथा। आसीद्दुर्योधनस्यापि स्थितः सिंह इवाहवे॥४१॥
समुद्यतगदं दृष्ट्वा कैलासमिव शृङ्गिणम्। भीमसेनस्तदा राजन् दुर्योधनमथाब्रवीत्॥४२॥
verses.english: Seeing him stand there with uplifted mace like the created mountain of Kailasa, Bhimasena, O monarch, addressed him, saying "Remember all those wrongs that king Dhritarashtra and yourself have inflicted on us. Remember what took place at Varanavata.

verses.sanskrit: राज्ञापि धृतराष्ट्रेण त्वया चास्मासु यत्कृतम्। स्मर तद्दृष्कृतं कर्म यद्भूतं वारणावते॥४३॥
द्रौपदी च परिक्लिष्टा सभामध्ये रजस्वला। द्यूते यद्विजितो राजा शकुनेर्बुद्धिनिश्चयात्॥४४॥
यानि चान्यानि दुष्टात्मन्पापानि कृतवानसि। अनागःसु च पार्थेषु तस्य पश्य महत्फलम्॥४५॥
त्वकृते निहतः शेते शरतल्पे महायशाः। गाङ्गेयो भरतश्रेष्ठः सर्वेषां नः पितामहः॥४६॥
verses.english: It is for you that, that illustrious chief of the Bharatas, the son of Ganga, the grandfather of us all, lies now on a bed of arrows.

verses.sanskrit: हतो द्रोणश्च कर्णश्च हतः शल्यः प्रतापवान्। वैरस्त चादिकर्ताऽसौ शकुनिर्निहतो रणे॥४७॥
verses.english: Drona also has been killed. Karna has been killed. Shalya of great valour has been killed. Yonder Shakuni also, the root of these enunities, has been killed in battle.

verses.sanskrit: भ्रातरस्ते हताः शूराः पुत्राश्च सहसैनिकाः। राजानश्च हताः शूराः समरेष्वनिवर्तिनः॥४८॥
verses.english: Your heroic brothers and sons, with all your troops, have been killed. Other heroic kings also, who never retreated from battle, have been killed.

verses.sanskrit: बृंहन्ति कुञ्जरास्तत्र हया द्वेषन्ति चासकृत्। शस्त्राणि सम्प्रदीप्यन्ते पाण्डवानां जयैषिणाम्॥४८॥
verses.english: Your heroic brothers and sons, with all your troops, have been killed. Other heroic kings also, who never retreated from battle, have been killed.

verses.sanskrit: एते चान्ये च निहता बहवः क्षत्रियर्षभाः। प्रातिकामी तथा पापो द्रौपद्याः केशकृद्धतः॥४९॥
verses.english: These and many other leading Kshatriyas, as also Pratikamin, that wretch who had seized the locks of Draupadi, have been killed.

verses.sanskrit: अवशिष्टस्त्वमेवैकः कुलघ्नोऽधमपूरुषः। त्वामप्यद्य हनिष्यामि गदया नात्र संशयः॥५०॥
अद्य तेऽहं रणे दर्पं सर्वं नाशयिता नृप। राज्याशां विपुलां राजन् पाण्डवेषु च दुष्कृतम्॥५१॥

दुर्योधन उवाच।
              किं कत्थितेन बहुना युद्ध्यस्वाद्य मया सह। अद्य तेऽहं विनेष्यामि युद्धश्रद्धां वृकोदर॥५२॥
verses.english: Duryodhana said What is the use of speaking too much? Fight now with me. Today O Vrikodara, I shall subdue you desire for battle.

verses.sanskrit: किं न पश्यमि मां पाप गदायुद्धे व्यवस्थितम्। हिमवच्छिखराकारां प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम्॥५३॥
verses.english: Why do you not see me, O wretch, standing here for an encounter with the mace? Am I not armed with a formidable mace that looks like a summit of Himavat?

verses.sanskrit: गदिनं कोऽध मां पाप हन्तुमुत्सहते रिपुः। न्यायतो युद्ध्यमानश्च देवेष्वपि पुरन्दरः॥५४॥
verses.english: What enemy is there, O wretch, that would dare defeat me armed with this weapon? If it be a fair fight, Purandara himself, amongst the celestials, is not capable of doing it.

verses.sanskrit: मा वृथा गर्ज कौन्तेय शारदाभ्रमिवाजलम्। दर्शयस्व बलं युद्धे यावत्तत्तेऽद्य विद्यते॥५५॥
verses.english: Do not, O son of Kunti, roar uselessly in this way like autumnal clouds shorn of water. Display all the strength you posses in battle now.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पाण्डवाः सहसृञ्जयाः। सर्वे सम्पूजयामासुस्तद्वचो विजिगीषवः॥५६॥
उन्मत्तमिव मातङ्गं तलशब्देन मानवाः। भूयः संहर्षयामासू राजन् दुर्योधनं नृपम्॥५७॥
verses.english: Like men exciting an infuriate elephant with the clapping of hands, all of them then pleased king Duryodhana.
